en.headline: Windsurfers take two golds as Hong Kong reaches 10 Asian Games titles
en.dek: Wong Tsz-ho and Cheung Tsz-yuet won the youth iQFOiL events in Nagoya, taking the gold count to 10, RTHK reported.
body: Hong Kong windsurfers Wong Tsz-ho and Cheung Tsz-yuet won gold in the boys' and girls' youth iQFOiL events at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Saturday, taking the delegation's gold-medal count to 10 and past the previous Games, RTHK reported.

RTHK said Wong finished the 11-race series with a net score of 13 after six race wins and two discards, five points ahead of the Japanese sailor in second. In the scoring system, the lower total ranks higher. Cheung recorded nine race wins and a net score of 9, eight points clear of the Japanese sailor in second.

Ma Kwan-ching took silver in the women's iQFOiL, RTHK said. The South China Morning Post reported that the youth titles followed Coleman Wong's men's singles tennis gold earlier on Saturday, and that the two windsurfing wins put Hong Kong's gold count into double figures for the first time since the city began competing at the Games in 1954.

The Sing Tao sports desk also reported a silver for Wong Tsz-hei in the girls' ILCA 4 and a bronze for Cheng Kai-ngo in the boys' ILCA 4 on the same day, and said the sailing team closed its programme with two golds, three silvers and two bronzes. The Games continue through Sunday.

zh.headline: 滑浪風帆青年組連奪兩金 港隊亞運金牌增至十面
zh.dek: 港台報道，黃梓豪及張子悅在名古屋分別奪得男女子青少年水翼帆板金牌，馬君正摘女子銀牌。
body: 港隊滑浪風帆選手黃梓豪及張子悅周六在名古屋亞運分別奪得男子及女子青少年水翼帆板iQFOiL金牌。港台報道，港隊今屆金牌數目增至十面，超越上屆。
港台引述賽果指，黃梓豪在11輪賽事中有6輪第一，扣除兩輪最差成績後淨得分13分，較第二名日本選手少5分。賽制以分數較低者排名較前。張子悅在11輪中有9場第一，淨得分9分，較第二名日本選手少8分。
港台又指，馬君正在女子水翼帆板iQFOiL取得銀牌。《南華早報》報道，兩面青年組金牌是在黃澤林先後奪得男子網球單打金牌之後取得，並指這是香港自1954年參加亞運以來，金牌數目首次進入雙位數。
《星島》體育版同日報道，黃子曦在女子青年單人艇ILCA 4取得銀牌，鄭祺翱在男子青年單人艇ILCA 4取得銅牌，帆船隊以兩金、三銀、兩銅結束項目。亞運賽事至周日結束。
